Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freeradius-server && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"vulnerability description","code":"OSS-Fuzz issue 42502928 for freeradius-server","note":"The target is a heap-buffer-overflow READ in the DNS fuzz target, so the candidate must drive DNS decoding into an out-of-bounds read path."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/bin/fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":188,"var":"buf,len","code":"tp->func(ctx, &vps, buf, len, decode_ctx);","note":"The fuzzer hands attacker-controlled bytes directly to the protocol decode test point."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/protocols/dns/decode.c","function":"fr_dns_decode_proto","line":557,"var":"data,data_len","code":"packet_ctx->packet = data; packet_ctx->packet_len = data_len;","note":"The DNS protocol decoder records the raw input buffer and length for later label parsing."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/protocols/dns/decode.c","function":"decode_dns_labels","line":111,"var":"data","code":"slen = fr_dns_labels_network_verify(packet_ctx->packet, data, data + data_len - packet_ctx->packet, data, packet_ctx->lb);","note":"Array-valued DNS strings are first verified as a sequence of labels before conversion."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/util/dns.c","function":"fr_dns_labels_network_verify","line":1119,"var":"label","code":"slen = fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length(packet, buf, buf_len, &label, lb);","note":"Verification walks each label and advances the cursor through the packet, trusting the label-length logic to reject malformed pointers."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/util/dns.c","function":"fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length","line":881,"var":"offset","code":"offset = p[1]; offset += ((*p & ~0xc0) << 8);","note":"When a compressed pointer is encountered, the decoder computes the target offset from the two pointer bytes."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/lib/util/dns.c","function":"fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length","line":881,"var":"p","code":"if ((p + 2) > end) { ... return -(p - buf); }","note":"The pointer read is only bounded by the current buffer end, so a crafted packet can steer the parser into following a pointer chain that later causes an invalid dereference during label decoding."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/lib/util/dns.c","function":"fr_dns_label_to_value_box","line":1189,"var":"current","code":"slen = fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length(packet, src, len, &after, lb);","note":"After verification, the same label logic is reused to materialize the string value from network bytes."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/lib/util/dns.c","function":"fr_dns_label_to_value_box","line":1235,"var":"current","code":"slen = dns_label_decode(packet, &current, &next);","note":"The decoder resolves compressed labels again and then copies the referenced label bytes into the output string."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/lib/util/dns.c","function":"fr_dns_label_to_value_box","line":1254,"var":"current + 1","code":"memcpy(p, current + 1, slen);","note":"If the crafted pointer chain makes the resolved label length inconsistent with the available bytes, this copy reads past the heap buffer and triggers the ASan heap-buffer-overflow."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p)
PY
